mapper.sql: id, episode_id, video_id, filename, mime, size_bytes, vertical, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.episode_id, u.video_id, u.filename, u.mime, u.size_bytes, u.vertical, u.status, u.created_at FROM media_uploads u JOIN episodes e ON e.id = u.episode_id JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE u.video_id = #{videoId} AND d.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
SELECT FROM media_uploads WHERE episode_id = #{episodeId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM media_uploads WHERE episode_id = #{episodeId} AND video_id = #{videoId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT episode_id AS episodeId, status AS status FROM media_uploads WHERE episode_id IN #{episodeId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE media_uploads SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE media_uploads SET status = #{status}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes} WHERE id = #{id}
